steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Catholic Christians also believe in purgatory — a state of purification after death for those who will eventually enter heaven but need to be cleansed of venial sins. | RS Exam Tips — The Afterlife: 1. For The Afterlife questions, always include specific scriptural or source references where relevant 2. Explain both religious and non-religious viewpoints 3. Use specialist vocabulary precisely (e.g. terms from the specification) 4. Evaluate by analysing strengths and weaknesses of different views before reaching your conclusion 5. Link your discussion of The Afterlife to its real-world impact on believers and society
